verdict: Paid leads surging, but zero are reaching your case pipeline.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $13.08 per lead — a strong and efficient result, with cost per lead dropping 22.91% compared to the prior week. The issue is downstream: none of those leads have converted into opportunities in your pipeline, which points to an intake gap rather than an advertising one. SMS automation and voice access needed to reach leads quickly are still not in place, and four consecutive days of zero Google Business Profile activity show organic discovery has also gone quiet while paid performance holds. Both items are being addressed now, with automation and contact tools targeted for activation this month.
